title: Linear Z-shaped MF
text: Linear z-shaped saturation membership function, 1 input, 1 output; {Left point a} sets the leftmost point of transition area and {Right point b} sets the rightmost point of transition area. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Left point a
params.values: Leftmost point of transition area 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Right point b
params.values: Rightmost point of transition area 6 (default) | scalar
